service.en: Issue a school food supply permit
service.ur: اسکول فوڈ سپلائی پرمٹ کا اجرا

about: Get a permit to supply food to government or private schools or universities.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: List of meals served at the school
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
